children: R. Adam Lindsay, managing member of Powell Anderson Capital Partners LLC, disclosed a 6.8% stake in Franklin Street Properties Corp. The Schedule 13D was filed on Oct. 14, 2026, reflecting purchases made through PACP Acadia LLC, Powell Anderson Capital LP, and personal holdings. The move signals potential engagement on strategy, capital allocation, and board composition.

Lindsay says the group bought shares because they viewed Franklin Street Properties as undervalued and a compelling opportunity. They plan to stay flexible and could buy more or sell shares over time.

They also opened the door to active steps, including “engaging in communications with management and the Board of Directors” and “making recommendations or proposals… concerning changes to the capitalization, ownership structure, board structure… or suggestions for improving the Issuer’s financial and/or operational performance.” The group may also explore business combinations or property sales and consider hedging.

R. Adam Lindsay manages Powell Anderson Capital Partners LLC, which invests in public securities and oversees PACP Acadia LLC and Powell Anderson Capital LP. The firms are Delaware entities that focus on buying, holding, voting, and selling public company stakes. Lindsay’s approach centers on value and hands-on engagement when he sees room to improve strategy or capital deployment.
